central_boundary.change: Only workflow source SHA changes; Dockerfile unchanged.

semantic_findings: Home-authorized local plugin execution for acp/ models: CPA asks the operator's Home over the existing Redis command channel (model, headers, query); Home returns plugin/version/config digest, and CPA only runs an already-loaded local plugin whose version and config digest match and whose model is unchanged.
Plugin shadow copies get a unique path when the same native image is reloaded; plugin static model catalog read API.
Codex websocket read deadlines extended via net.Conn while a turn is active; duplex create/steer bookkeeping.
No new hosts, exec, env reads, file writes or embeds.
limitations: Native plugins and external Home not newly approved.
